title: fix(react,vue): forward multiCursor through Editor components
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Forward `multiCursor` from the React/Vue `<Editor />` wrapper components to the core editor config.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

- Issue: N/A
- Roadmap: N/A
- OpenSpec change: N/A

The core editor already supports the `multiCursor` option, and both React/Vue `useEditor` hooks can pass editor config through to `createEditor`.

However, the React and Vue `<Editor />` wrapper components did not forward the `multiCursor` prop to the core editor config. In React, the prop could also be forwarded to the DOM wrapper instead of being consumed by the editor component.

This PR fixes the wrapper behavior so framework users can enable or disable multi-cursor support through the existing `multiCursor` prop.

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/react`:
  - Forward `multiCursor` from the React `<Editor />` component to `useEditor`.
  - Add regression tests for both `multiCursor={true}` and `multiCursor={false}`.

- `packages/vue`:
  - Add `multiCursor` to Vue editor prop keys and runtime props.
  - Ensure `multiCursor` is included in the config passed to `useEditor`.
  - Add regression tests for both `multiCursor: true` and `multiCursor: false`.

- `packages/core`:
  - No changes. Core already supports `multiCursor`.

## Validation / 验证

- [x] `pnpm test -- packages/react/test/editor-react.test.tsx packages/vue/test/editor-vue.test.ts`
- [x] `pnpm test -- packages/core/test/multi-cursor.test.ts`
